name: Create a list
description: Create a list Creates a new list of the specified kind. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rules/lists
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rules/lists
Creates a new list of the specified kind.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Create list items
description: Create list items Appends new items to the list. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rules/lists/{list_id}/items
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rules/lists/{list_id}/items
Appends new items to the list. This operation is asynchronous. To get current the operation status, invoke the `Get bulk operation status` endpoint with the returned `operation_id`. There is a limit of 1 pending bulk operation per account. If an outstanding bulk operation is in progress, the request will be rejected.
Required: list_id (path); account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete a list
description: Delete a list Deletes a specific list and all its items. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rules/lists/{list_id}

name: Delete list items
description: Delete list items Removes one or more items from a list. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rules/lists/{list_id}/items
context:
DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rules/lists/{list_id}/items
Removes one or more items from a list. This operation is asynchronous. To get current the operation status, invoke the `Get bulk operation status` endpoint with the returned `operation_id`. There is a limit of 1 pending bulk operation per account. If an outstanding bulk operation is in progress, the request will be rejected.
Required: list_id (path); account_id (path); body (body)

name: Get a list
description: Get a list Fetches the details of a list. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rules/lists/{list_id}

name: Get a list item
description: Get a list item Fetches a list item in the list. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rules/lists/{list_id}/items/{item_id}

name: Get bulk operation status
description: Get bulk operation status Gets the current status of an asynchronous operation on a list. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rules/lists/bulk_operations/{operation_id}

name: Get list items
description: Get list items Fetches all the items in the list. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rules/lists/{list_id}/items
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rules/lists/{list_id}/items
Fetches all the items in the list.
Required: list_id (path); account_id (path)
Optional: cursor (query); per_page (query); search (query)

name: Get lists
description: Get lists Fetches all lists in the account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rules/lists
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rules/lists
Fetches all lists in the account.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Update a list
description: Update a list Updates the description of a list. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rules/lists/{list_id}

name: Update all list items
description: Update all list items Removes all existing items from the list and adds the provided items to the list. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rules/lists/{list_id}/items
context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rules/lists/{list_id}/items
Removes all existing items from the list and adds the provided items to the list. This operation is asynchronous. To get current the operation status, invoke the `Get bulk operation status` endpoint with the returned `operation_id`. There is a limit of 1 pending bulk operation per account. If an outstanding bulk operation is in progress, the request will be rejected.
Required: list_id (path); account_id (path); body (body)
